title: SaveSpecMetadata
description: **Removed.** `SaveSpecMetadata` validated and persisted arbitrary caller-supplied metadata JSON, including agent-authored optimized fields. Its guarded-persistence responsibility (validate a complete generated projection, then conditionally write) moves to `PersistSpecMetadata`, an internal collaborator used only by `MaterializeSpecMetadata`. Unlike `SaveSpecMetadata`, `PersistSpecMetadata` accepts only a complete generated projection plus an observed revision — it is not a general-purpose metadata-editing operation and is never exposed on Kernel, Core public exports, SDK, CLI, or MCP.

rules: `SaveSpecMetadata` MUST NOT be exported from `@specd/core`, MUST NOT be mounted on `Kernel`, and MUST NOT have a public `createSaveSpecMetadata` composition factory. Arbitrary metadata persistence is no longer an application operation reachable by any host. The only remaining metadata writer is the internal `PersistSpecMetadata` collaborator invoked by `MaterializeSpecMetadata`, which accepts a complete generated projection and observed `revision` — never a caller-supplied partial or arbitrary JSON payload.

scenarios.name: SaveSpecMetadata is not exported
then: SaveSpecMetadata and createSaveSpecMetadata are not present

scenarios.name: Kernel does not mount SaveSpecMetadata
then: the returned kernel has no saveSpecMetadata entry under kernel.specs

scenarios.name: PersistSpecMetadata is the only remaining metadata writer, and only for MaterializeSpecMetadata
then: it is invoked only by MaterializeSpecMetadata
AND it accepts only a complete generated projection plus an observed revision — never a caller-supplied partial or arbitrary JSON payload
